content: {"praised":["Season 3 is still a great season of an even greater show","It wraps up most loose ends of the series","The final season delivers a strong, dramatic conclusion","New characters like Ultra Magnus and Predaking add excitement","The tone remains dark yet hopeful, fitting the climax"],"criticized":["Season 3 has only 13 episodes, shorter than earlier seasons","It is not as great as seasons 1 or 2","Some loose ends remain unresolved, especially from the movie","The pacing feels uneven in a few episodes","Ultra Magnus feels too by-the-book in some scenes"]}
